title: Micro-commit release lane and field notes
content:
Context:
Quick, low-risk micro-commit lane for small feature and infra changes that must reach prod within 48 hours. Goal: move fast while keeping deterministic safety checks and a compact incident decision ladder. This doc is a working field notebook (notes-to-self, checkboxes) — use it as the single source for this sprint's micro-release window.

Goals and constraints:
- Ship small surface-area changes (<1% traffic impact).
- End-to-end deploy within a 48h window (code -> prod) with a max 2hr monitoring watch after full traffic shift.
- Keep rollback surface minimal; prefer toggles/config flips over code-level rollbacks.

Release windows (this run):
- Wed 2027-07-14 09:00–11:00 PDT: Canary (internal + 1% traffic)
- Wed 2027-07-14 12:00–14:00 PDT: Ramp to 10% if canary green
- Wed 2027-07-14 16:00–18:00 PDT: Ramp to 50% if metrics stable
- Thu 2027-07-15 09:00–10:00 PDT: Full traffic switch (post-approval)

Preflight (must be green before starting):
- [ ] PR merged and image pushed: runtime/service:sha-abcdef
- [ ] CI smoke tests passed (unit + integration) — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/actions/runs/98765
- [ ] Canary config baked and validated in staging (canary profile: micro-commit-2027-07)
- [ ] Release notes draft posted in #release-ops and assigned reviewers (Maya, Noah)
- [ ] Rollback toggle prepared (feature_flag: micro_commit_enable) and tested in staging
- [ ] Observability checklist: dashboards created, golden metrics defined, alerts scoped (see Observability section)
- [ ] SRE on-call: Jules (primary) & fallback: Sofia — confirmed availability

Canary step (1% internal + synthetic traffic):
- Trigger: ops/rolling-deploy with canary policy=1pct-internal
- Smoke checklist during canary (EVERY 5m for 20m):
  - [ ] error-rate (p50/p95/p99) within baseline + 0.5% absolute
  - [ ] latency p95 not exceed baseline + 20ms
  - [ ] memory/CPU per-host no unexpected spike > 10%
  - [ ] kv-cache hit-rate within normal variance
  - [ ] partial-request traces sanity (no new error buckets)
- If any smoke fails: abort and rollback to previous image, collect traces and open a linear ticket RED-xxxxx.

Ramp policy (10% -> 50% -> 100%):
- 10%: automated after 60m stable canary and signoff from release lead (Maya)
- 50%: after 2h at 10% and zero new regressions; SRE runbook step flow executed
- 100%: manual authorization from product and SRE (explicit thumbs-up in #release-ops)

Rollback triggers (explicit):
- sustained error-rate increase > 1% above baseline for 30m
- p95 latency regression > 50ms for 20m
- new 5xx spike clustered on a single handler/function
- merchant/customer-facing degradation flagged in support channels
- automated chaos protection firing (safety throttle engaged)

Rollback steps (fast path):
1) Flip feature_flag: micro_commit_enable -> OFF (if deploy uses flags).
2) If flags not present or flagged failure persists, trigger rolling rollback to runtime/service:sha-prev via deploy tooling.
3) Notify #release-ops, on-call SRE, product owner. Create short incident stub in Linear.
4) Collect core logs (last 30m), heap samples if OOM suspected, representative traces; pin to Linear ticket.

Observability (golden metrics + dashboards):
- Golden metrics: request_rate, 5xx_rate, latency_p95, kv_cache_hit_pct, model_kv_hit_rate, model_token_throughput, infra_cpu_pct
- Dashboards to open: micro-commit-2027-canary (time range preset: last 120m)
- Pager suppressions: only escalate if 5xx_rate > threshold or latency regression sustained
- Tracing: sample rate bumped to 100% for canary hosts for first 60m

Telemetry quick checks (to run after each ramp):
- grep logs for new error signature strings (hint: "hash-mismatch", "kv-miss-unwrap")
- query: sum by (handler) (rate(errors[5m])) — look for concentration
- check deployment metadata: git_sha, image_tag, config_hash consistency

Comm plan (short):
- Preflight: post checklist in #release-ops 30m prior to canary; mention SRE on-call
- Canary green: update #release-ops with thumbs-up and timestamp
- Every ramp: one-line update with metric highlights
- Any abort/rollback: immediate @channel, link Linear ticket, list primary next steps
- Post-success: short release notes and changelog entry (see Release Notes section)

Post-release smoke & validation (first 2 hours):
- [ ] Run spot-check synthetics hitting the new code paths (3 scenarios)
- [ ] Validate top-10 customer journeys via manual QA sheet
- [ ] Confirm billing/usage pipeline reports normal ingestion (no gaps)
- [ ] Confirm no regressions in model outputs for evaluation prompts (small eval run)

Release notes (draft — edit before publish):
- Title: micro-commit: better kv-cache stability and small latency improvements
- Summary: small runtime change to reduce kv-cache thrash under thin-cache scenarios. Improves p95 tail by ~12ms on i1 nodes for small prompts. No customer-facing API changes.
- PRs: runtime#4310 — reduce lock contention in kv manager; infra#209 — canary config for micro-commit lane
- Known issues: under extremely high parallelism (>= 16 concurrent streams) we may still see rare kv-miss logging; we are tracking this in RED-1489.
- Rollout plan: staged over July 14–15 in the micro-commit lane, see internal schedule.

Open questions / TODOs:
- [ ] Confirm with security whether the new tracing sample bump needs extra retention policy signoff. @Noah
- [ ] Finalize canary synthetic scenarios (Jules)
- [ ] Coordinate with CS for pre-batched customer notifications if RED-1489 escalates

Notes to self (fragile/observations):
- Keep watch for correlated GC events during ramp; previous micro-commits saw a 1-2% p99 blip tied to small config drift.
- If rolling to 50% produces a small p95 blip but p99 is fine, consider holding at 10% and extend monitoring rather than immediate rollback.

Postmortem skeleton (if needed):
- Timeline (events with timestamps)
- Trigger and immediate actions (what flipped)
- Root cause hypothesis and evidence (traces, diffs)
- Mitigations and permanent fixes (owner + ETA)
- Blameless retro notes and follow-ups

Quick checklist (final):
- [ ] All preflight nodes green
- [ ] Observability dashboards up and warmed
- [ ] On-call confirmed and pagers scoped
- [ ] Rollback toggle ready and tested
- [ ] Release notes posted (internal)
- [ ] Post-release QA slot scheduled

History / edits log:
- 2027-07-10: initial sketch (Maya)
- 2027-07-12: added telemetry checks and rollback lattice (Jules)

Fingerprint: micro-commit-lane-2027-07-v0.3

End of doc.
